name: process_bench_diversity_labels_excl_math
description: A labeled dataset that annotates diversity-related labels for process-oriented tasks, with math problems excluded. It is intended to measure models' ability to produce or recognize diverse problem-solving processes and labeling decisions across non-mathematical tasks. Typical use is classification/labeling of diversity categories for process outputs.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset useful for process-diversity research; modest adoption mainly among researchers studying reasoning diversity and evaluation.
